context: Hina-young tries voice-assistant tech; teaches Yumiko how to use it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、これ、声で動くの!
lines.en: Grandma, Grandma — this one responds to your voice!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick breath before the reveal. Warm and excited without being performative. The pride of showing something she loves to someone she wants to impress.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Oh, that is convenient, isn't it…
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. A slight pause before speaking, like she's catching up to the technology. Genuine warmth — not patronizing, but genuinely charmed by this small marvel.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Go on, try talking to it — look!
lines.style: Encouraging and light. Leans forward slightly in her voice. No pressure — just inviting, generous with her enthusiasm to guide her grandmother forward.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Um… what's the weather going to be?
lines.style: Hesitant, a little self-conscious. Soft pause before asking. Speaks to the device like she's not quite sure it will work, but willing to try because her granddaughter asked her to.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: すごいでしょ、おばあちゃん!
lines.style: Triumphant and bright. Quick attack on the opening word. Voice full of the joy of being right, of having shared something wonderful. No smugness — pure delight in her grandmother's moment.
